punchline: The pharmacist said, "No, that\'s it starting."

title: THE EYE CHART
setup: The optometrist asked me to read the smallest line. I said, "Payment due at time of service."
punchline: "Perfect vision," she said. "Terrible news."

title: A SENSITIVE PROCEDURE
setup: Before the prostate exam, the doctor said, "Try to relax." I said, "Could you at least buy me dinner first?"
punchline: He replied, "With your insurance? This is dinner."

title: THE HEALTHY CHOICE
setup: The cardiologist told me red wine can be good for the heart. I asked how much. He said, "One glass."
punchline: I changed cardiologists. This one clearly lacked ambition.

title: THE NEW HEARING AID
setup: My hearing aid is so advanced I can hear people whisper from across the room.
punchline: Unfortunately, it still cannot make them say anything nice.

title: THE PRESCRIPTION
setup: The pharmacist stared at my doctor\'s handwriting for ten minutes.
punchline: Finally he said, "I can give you antibiotics, sleeping pills, or a small dog. Any of those could be what he wrote."

title: THE CAMERA TEST
setup: Before my colonoscopy, the doctor promised the camera was tiny.
punchline: I said, "Then why does the consent form have a film credit section?"

title: A NATURAL RESULT
setup: The plastic surgeon asked what result I wanted. I said, "Natural."
punchline: He looked at my payment history and said, "Then age gracefully and get out."

title: A SECOND READING
setup: The nurse said my blood pressure was dangerously high.
punchline: I asked her to remove the bill from my hand and check again.

title: A BREAKTHROUGH SESSION
setup: My therapist says I use humor to avoid my feelings. We both laughed.
punchline: Well, I laughed. She adjusted the invoice.

title: THREE VISITS
setup: A doctor opens a clinic with a sign: "Treatment: \$20. Not cured? Get \$100 back." A lawyer smells easy money. "I\'ve lost my sense of taste." The doctor gives him three drops. "That\'s kerosene!" "Excellent---your taste is back. Twenty dollars." The lawyer returns claiming memory loss. The doctor reaches for the same bottle. "That\'s kerosene!" "Your memory is back. Twenty dollars." On his third visit, the lawyer claims he cannot see. The doctor hands him a twenty-dollar bill. "This is only twenty, not a hundred!" The doctor smiles. "Your eyesight is back.
punchline: Twenty dollars."

title: LIGHT EXERCISE
setup: My friend asked why I was sweating so hard. I said, "I opened a jar."
punchline: He nodded like I had completed a triathlon.

title: HOUSE RULES
setup: A patient says, "Doctor, I think I'm a dog." The doctor points to the couch. "Lie down."
punchline: The patient says, "I'm not allowed on the furniture."

title: MEMORY LOSS
setup: A man tells his doctor, "I'm losing my memory." The doctor asks, "Since when?"
punchline: The patient says, "Since when what?"

title: THE COUNTDOWN
setup: A patient asks, "Doctor, how long do I have?" The doctor checks his watch. "Ten... nine...
punchline: eight..."

title: ROUTINE PROCEDURE
setup: Before surgery, a doctor says, "Don't worry. This is routine."
punchline: The patient asks, "For you or for me?"

title: SUPPORTING FITNESS
setup: I'm not against exercise.
punchline: I watch other people do it on television.

title: THE SLEEP AID
setup: A man asks a pharmacist for something that will keep him awake at night.
punchline: The pharmacist hands him a mortgage application.

title: THE UNUSUAL PET
setup: A young man finds a talking frog. "Kiss me and I\'ll become a beautiful princess," she says. He puts her in his pocket. "I\'ll stay with you for a week and do anything you want." He smiles and puts her back. Finally, the frog asks, "Why won\'t you kiss me?" The man shrugs. "I\'m an engineer.
punchline: I don\'t have time for a girlfriend, but a talking frog is amazing."

title: OPENING NIGHT
setup: An actor who keeps forgetting his lines finally gets a one-line role. The director says, "Walk on holding a rose, smell it, and say, 'Oh, the scent of my lover.'" On opening night, the actor enters on cue, raises his empty hand, and delivers the line perfectly. The audience bursts out laughing. Backstage, he asks, "Did I forget my line?"
punchline: The director shouts, "No---you forgot the rose!"

title: ROADSIDE ADVICE
setup: A driver gets a flat outside a psychiatric hospital and loses the wheel nuts. A patient watching from the wall says, "Take one nut from each of the other three wheels. That'll hold the spare until you reach a garage." The driver is amazed. "That's brilliant. Why are you in there?"
punchline: The patient shrugs. "I'm crazy, not stupid."

title: CORPORATE EFFICIENCY
setup: A CEO walks through his office and sees a man sitting on a sofa, scrolling through his phone. "What are you doing?" the CEO demands. "Wasting time until I get paid." "What\'s your weekly salary?" "One thousand dollars." Furious, the CEO counts out two thousand dollars and hands it to him. "Here\'s two weeks\' pay. Take it and get out. You don\'t work here anymore!" The man quietly takes the money and leaves. The CEO turns to the receptionist. "Who was that guy?"
punchline: "The pizza delivery driver."

title: PRIORITY CUSTOMER
setup: A man walks into a bank and snarls at the teller, "Listen, bitch, get me the asshole who runs this dump." She protests, but he keeps going. "Shut the hell up and call the idiot who owns this place!" The bank manager rushes over. "Sir, I\'m the manager. What seems to be the problem?" "I just won a hundred and fifty million dollars in the lottery, and I want to deposit it here."
punchline: The manager immediately turns to the teller. "I see. Is this bitch giving you trouble?"

title: FIELD TECHNICIAN
setup: A woman spends four hours assembling an IKEA wardrobe. A city bus rumbles over the cobblestones outside, the apartment shakes, and the wardrobe collapses. She rebuilds it. The next bus passes, and it falls again. Furious, she calls IKEA. A technician arrives, rebuilds it, then climbs inside to locate the defect when the next bus goes by. At that moment, the woman\'s husband comes home, opens the wardrobe, and finds a man crouching inside.
punchline: The technician looks up. "You\'re never going to believe this, but I\'m waiting for the bus."

title: THREE OPERATING SYSTEMS
setup: Three software engineers meet at the restroom sink. The Windows engineer uses gallons of water, half the soap, and a stack of towels. "At Windows, we're thorough." The Apple engineer uses a splash of water, three drops of soap, and half a towel. "At Apple, we're thorough and efficient." The Linux engineer heads for the door. "Aren't you washing your hands?"
punchline: "At Linux, we don't pee on our fingers."

title: ARCHAEOLOGICAL BREAKTHROUGH
setup: Russian archaeologists dig 300 feet and find thousand-year-old copper wire. They announce that ancient Russians had wired communications. Americans dig 600 feet and find two-thousand-year-old glass fibers. They announce that ancient Americans had fiber optics a thousand years earlier. Belgian archaeologists dig three miles and find nothing.
punchline: They proudly announce that ancient Belgians had wireless internet five thousand years ago.

title: THE OLD CLAIM TICKET
setup: A man returns to New York after forty-five years away. In his old neighborhood, he finds the tiny shoe-repair shop he used before he left. He checks his wallet and discovers a claim ticket for a pair of loafers he never picked up. Inside, an ancient cobbler examines it. "Brown loafers? Left shoe needed a new sole?" "Yes! Exactly!"
punchline: The cobbler disappears into the back room, returns, and says, "They\'ll be ready Thursday."

title: SUPPORTING EVIDENCE
setup: During an IRS audit, the agent says, "You report an income of only \$1,800 a month. How do you explain your beach house in Malibu, your Manhattan condo, and your ranch in Texas?" The taxpayer replies, "One night I dreamed there was treasure under a tree in my mother\'s yard. The next morning, I dug there and found it." The agent raises an eyebrow. "Do you have any proof of that story?"
punchline: "Of course: my beach house in Malibu, my Manhattan condo, and my ranch in Texas."

title: SECRET BAIT
setup: A bartender asks a customer, "What are you having?" "A whiskey." After drinking it, the customer refuses to pay. "You asked what I was having. I thought you were buying." The next day, he returns with a hard-boiled egg, cuts it into tiny cubes, and explains that he is making fishing bait. The curious bartender asks, "What do you catch with that?"
punchline: The customer smiles. "Mostly free whiskey."

title: CAMERA FIFTY
setup: A film crew has one chance to blow up a castle. Fifty cameras are positioned around the set. The director yells "Action!" and the castle explodes beautifully. But Camera One was out of focus. Camera Two lost power. Camera Three started late. One by one, forty-nine operators admit that they missed the shot. In tears, the director reaches the final cameraman. "Please tell me you got it."
punchline: The cameraman smiles. "I\'m ready whenever you are."

title: THE HIDDEN TALENT
setup: At a school for superheroes, the headmaster rolls his wheelchair up to a new student. "What is your power?" "I can tell exactly how many pulls it takes to stop a ceiling fan. That one takes three." The headmaster stands up, walks across the room, and pulls the chain three times. The fan stops. "Interesting," he says, "but that is not a superpower."
punchline: "I was joking," she replies. "My real power is healing people who cannot walk."

title: TODAY\'S SPECIAL
setup: A newly hired waitress copies the specials onto a chalkboard and accidentally writes, "TUNA MELT --- \$6; CHEF\'S HAND JOB --- \$11." A trucker asks, "Are you the one who gives the chef\'s hand jobs?" "Yes. Why?" "Then wash your hands.
punchline: I\'ll have the tuna melt."

title: THE BETTER LAWYER
setup: What\'s the difference between a good lawyer and a great lawyer?
punchline: A good lawyer knows the law. A great lawyer knows the judge.

title: THE PACKED LUNCH
setup: Three construction workers eat lunch high above the street. Bill finds another burger, Tony finds pasta again, and Chuck finds the same fish sandwich. Each vows to jump if he gets the same lunch tomorrow. The next day, all three lunches are identical. All three men jump.
punchline: At the funeral, Bill\'s and Tony\'s widows cry that they would have packed something else if they had known. Chuck\'s widow says, "I don\'t understand. He packed his own lunch."

title: THE LONG RIDE
setup: A driver picks up a hitchhiker. "How far are you going?" "As far as you can take me." The driver crosses the city, the state line, and finally reaches San Diego. "This is as far as I can go."
punchline: "Perfect. I live right across the street."

title: MINIMAL MATERIALS
setup: An engineer, a physicist, and a mathematician must build a fence around sheep using the least material. The engineer packs the flock into a circle and fences it. The physicist starts with an enormous circle and keeps shrinking it.
punchline: The mathematician builds a tiny fence around himself and declares, "I define myself as being outside."

title: NO EXCUSES
setup: A professor warns her class that nobody may miss tomorrow's mechanics exam without a genuine emergency. A joker in the back asks, "What about extreme exhaustion from too much romance?"
punchline: After the laughter dies down, the professor smiles. "Then you'll write with your other hand."

title: THE THIRD OPINION
setup: A physicist, a biologist, and a mathematician watch two people enter a house. Five minutes later, three people leave. The physicist says, "The original measurement was wrong." The biologist says, "They reproduced."
punchline: The mathematician says, "If one person goes inside now, the house will be empty."

title: FULL SERVICE
setup: A man walks into a bar. "How much is a Coke?" "Five dollars for the Coke and five dollars for service." The man hands over ten dollars. The bartender gives five back. "Why did you return five dollars?"
punchline: "Because we\'re out of Coke."

title: BUDGET LANGUAGE SCHOOL
setup: A man compares English grammar classes. Every teacher charges fifty dollars an hour except one ad: PERFECT ENGLISH GRAMMAR - \$5 AN HOUR He goes to the address and knocks. "Is this the five-dollar English teacher?"
punchline: A voice from inside replies, "Yes. You is at the right place."

title: OLD DRINKING BUDDY
setup: Every day, a man orders two whiskeys at the same bar. He explains, "My best friend and I always drank together in the Army. We lost touch, so I drink one for him and one for me." Six months later, he orders only one. The bartender asks gently, "Did your friend die?"
punchline: "No. I quit drinking."

title: OFFICE HOURS
setup: During a job interview, a veteran explains that a land mine took both testicles. The manager hires him and says, "Office hours are eight to four, but you can come in at ten." "I don\'t want special treatment."
punchline: "It isn\'t special treatment. Everyone here spends eight to ten scratching their balls."

title: THE FIRST STEP
setup: A woman in a skin-tight skirt cannot climb onto a bus. She discreetly lowers a zipper behind her, tries again, then lowers it farther. A man suddenly lifts her onto the step. "What gives you the right to touch me?"
punchline: "That\'s the second time you\'ve unzipped my fly. I figured we were getting close."

title: THE FISHING LICENSE
setup: A game warden catches a man with a bucket full of fish. "They\'re my pets," the man says. "Every evening I let them swim, then whistle and they come back." To prove it, he pours them into the lake. Minutes later, the warden asks when he plans to call them back.
punchline: "Call who back?"

title: TONIGHT\'S DINNER
setup: A woman thinks she is losing her hearing. From across the house, she asks her butler what he is cooking. No answer. She asks again while getting closer, then stands directly behind him. "James, what are you making for dinner?"
punchline: "Beef stew. That\'s the fourth time I\'ve told you."

title: SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE
setup: David runs into Morris. "I heard your store burned down!"
punchline: Morris checks his watch. "That\'s next week."

title: THE RED LIGHT
setup: A police officer stops a driver. "Didn\'t you see the red light?"
punchline: "I saw the light. I didn\'t see you."

title: SAVING AMMUNITION
setup: In the middle of a heated battle, I pulled a knife to save ammunition.
punchline: For some reason, all the other paintball players completely freaked out.

title: UNEXPECTED ENGINEERING
setup: When one door closes, another one opens.
punchline: Other than that, it\'s a pretty good car.

title: TWO METALS
setup: What\'s the difference between an iron superhero and an aluminum superhero?
punchline: The iron hero stops the bad guys. The aluminum hero foils their plans.

title: MEDICATION SIDE EFFECTS
setup: I left my ADHD medication in a Ford Fiesta.
punchline: When I came back, it had become a Ford Focus.

title: THE ORAL EXAM
setup: A boy from a family that has never once talked to the police is sent in for an oral exam. His father waits all day, sick with worry.
punchline: That evening the boy comes home beaming. "Dad, you would have been proud. They questioned me for two hours and I didn't say a word."

title: THE ROOM RATES
setup: A traveler asks a hotel for its room rates. "A thousand dollars on the first floor, eight hundred on the second, and six hundred on the third." The traveler thanks the clerk and leaves. "Too expensive?"
punchline: "No. Your hotel just isn\'t tall enough for me."

title: THE CAUTIOUS DRIVER
setup: A cabdriver speeds through three red lights. Each time his passenger protests, he says, "Don\'t worry. My brother-in-law does this all the time." At the fourth intersection, the light is green, but the driver slams on the brakes. "Why stop now?"
punchline: "My brother-in-law might be coming the other way."

title: WINTER GEAR
setup: A teacher struggles for ten minutes to pull boots onto a child. "They\'re on the wrong feet," he says. She removes them and starts again. "Those aren\'t my boots. They\'re my brother\'s, but Mom said I have to wear them." The teacher starts over once more, then asks, "Where are your gloves?"
punchline: "Inside my boots."

title: A HELPFUL NOTE
setup: A man finds his car smashed in a parking lot. A note is tucked under the windshield wiper:
punchline: "I hit your car. Everyone is watching and thinks I am leaving my contact information. I am not."

title: SCIENTIFIC DATING
setup: At a museum, a visitor asks the age of a dinosaur skeleton. "Six million years, five months, and three days." "How can you be so precise?"
punchline: "When I started working here five months and three days ago, they said it was six million years old."

title: THE REVISED HEADLINE
setup: In Dallas, a boy saves his friend by killing the pit bull attacking him. A reporter writes: "Young Cowboys Fan Heroically Saves Friend." "But I\'m a Giants fan," says the boy.
punchline: The reporter starts again: "Young Thug Cold-Bloodedly Murders Beloved Texas Family Pet."

title: THE SECRET INGREDIENT
setup: A restaurant customer can smell the towel on a waiter\'s arm and identify every dish being prepared. To fool him, the waiter takes the towel home and has his wife rub it between her legs. The next day, the customer sniffs it and looks surprised.
punchline: "Wait---Nicole works here now?"

title: GENIUS ARITHMETIC
setup: A psychiatrist asks three patients what seven times five equals. The first says "one thousand," the second says "Thursday," and the third says "thirty-five." "Excellent! How did you get that?"
punchline: "Easy. I divided one thousand by Thursday."

title: THE EXIT INTERVIEW
setup: HR asked why I was leaving. I said, "For a company that values honesty." They said, "We value honesty."
punchline: I said, "No, you value exit interviews."

title: THE REMOTE MEETING
setup: My boss asked why my camera was off during the video meeting. I said, "Bandwidth." He asked why my microphone was off.
punchline: "Employment preservation."

title: UNLIMITED VACATION
setup: Our company offers unlimited vacation.
punchline: You can take as much time as you want between being fired and finding another job.

title: THE HELPFUL REPLACEMENT
setup: My office installed an artificial-intelligence assistant.
punchline: It reads every email, schedules every meeting, and has already applied for my position.

title: PERFORMANCE GOALS
setup: My annual review said I need to show more initiative.
punchline: So I added a zero to my salary and sent it back for approval.

title: THE INTERNSHIP
setup: The job listing promised "valuable exposure."
punchline: It was unpaid, outdoors, and in January. For once, the advertisement was completely honest.

title: THE HONEST ATTORNEY
setup: A lawyer says, "I charge five hundred dollars for three questions." The client says, "Isn\'t that expensive?"
punchline: "Yes. What\'s your third question?"

title: THE OFFICE PRINTER
setup: The printer only jams when I am in a hurry.
punchline: It is the most emotionally intelligent machine in the building, and it hates me.

title: THE TRAINING VIDEO
setup: The workplace safety video began, "Everything you are about to see could have been prevented."
punchline: So I turned it off.

title: THE RIGHT PAPER
setup: A soldier picks up every scrap of paper he sees, studies it, and mutters, "That's not it." Doctors finally declare him unfit for duty and hand him his discharge papers.
punchline: He reads them, smiles, and says, "That's it!"

title: JOB SECURITY
setup: Working at the unemployment office must be stressful.
punchline: If they fire you, you still have to show up there the next morning.

title: THE GUILLOTINE
setup: A priest, a lawyer, and an engineer face the guillotine. The blade jams for the priest and lawyer, so both are released as acts of divine mercy.
punchline: The engineer lies down, looks up, and says, "Wait---I think I see the problem."

title: BUILDING CAPACITY
setup: Two mathematicians enter an empty building and three come out.
punchline: The security guard records an occupancy of minus one and is immediately promoted to accounting.

title: STATISTICAL ACCURACY
setup: An engineer shoots five feet left of a target. A physicist shoots five feet right.
punchline: The statistician cheers, "We hit it on average!"

title: PROOF OF DINNER
setup: An engineer, physicist, and mathematician are each locked in a room with canned food but no opener. The engineer dismantles the can. The physicist calculates the perfect angle to smash it.
punchline: The mathematician starves beside a board proving that a solution exists.

title: DEPARTMENT BUDGETS
setup: A dean complains, "Physics needs expensive laboratories. Mathematics only needs paper, pencils, and wastebaskets.
punchline: Philosophy is even cheaper---they don't need the wastebaskets."

title: PROFESSIONAL OFFENSE
setup: A man walks into a bar and shouts, "All lawyers are idiots!" A customer objects. "Why? Are you a lawyer?" "No.
punchline: I'm an idiot."

title: MEETING RESULTS
setup: A businessman walks into a bar after a three-hour meeting. The bartender asks what they decided.
punchline: "To schedule another meeting."

title: POSITIVE IDENTIFICATION
setup: Two atoms walk into a bar. One says, "I lost an electron." The other asks, "Are you sure?"
punchline: "I'm positive."

title: LEGAL REPRESENTATION
setup: A man in custody says, "I won't speak without my lawyer present." The officer says, "You are the lawyer." He replies, "Exactly.
punchline: So where's my present?"

title: PAYROLL ACCURACY
setup: An employee complains that his paycheck is fifty dollars short. Payroll replies, "Last month we overpaid you by fifty, and you never complained."
punchline: He says, "I can overlook one mistake, but not two in a row."

title: THE PRETTY FIELD
setup: An architect, engineer, and bricklayer debate who matters most. The architect says, "I design it." The engineer says, "I calculate it."
punchline: The bricklayer says, "Without me, you have a pretty drawing and beautiful math sitting in a field."

title: FAST MONEY
setup: A client asks a financial adviser, "How can I become a millionaire quickly?"
punchline: "Start as a billionaire and wait."

title: FOLLOWING DIRECTIONS
setup: A teacher asks why a student is late.
punchline: "The sign said 'School: Slow Down,' so I did."

title: THE RIGHT SPOT
setup: A customer wants an itemized bill for a five-minute plumbing repair. The plumber writes: "Hitting the pipe: one dollar.
punchline: Knowing where to hit it: one hundred forty-nine."

title: THE BOSS BIRD
setup: A pet shop sells three identical parrots for five hundred, one thousand, and two thousand dollars. The first knows computers; the second can program. "What does the expensive one do?" asks a customer. "No idea,"
punchline: says the clerk, "but the other two call him Boss."

title: ACADEMIC SOURCES
setup: Stealing one person's idea is plagiarism.
punchline: Stealing from many is research.

title: HARDWARE SUPPORT
setup: How many programmers does it take to change a light bulb? None.
punchline: That's a hardware problem.

title: EMOTIONAL SAVINGS
setup: I'm not cheap.
punchline: I'm emotionally attached to my money.

title: DECISION RIPENING
setup: I don't procrastinate.
punchline: I let decisions ripen until they rot.

title: THE PROCRASTINATION BOOK
setup: A man asks a librarian for a book about stopping procrastination.
punchline: "It should arrive next week."

title: THE EXPERIMENT
setup: A scientist tests a mouse's reflexes by removing its legs one at a time. After the fourth leg, the mouse no longer moves when ordered forward.
punchline: He writes: "Conclusion: removing all four legs causes hearing loss."

title: THE THIRD QUESTION
setup: Three nuns die in a car crash and arrive at the gates of heaven. St. Peter tells them that each must answer one question before entering. He asks the first nun, "What was the name of the first woman?" "Eve!" she replies. St. Peter welcomes her in. He asks the second nun, "Where did Adam and Eve live?" "The Garden of Eden!" She is welcomed in, too. St. Peter warns the Mother Superior that her question will be more difficult. She agrees that this is fair. "What did Eve say when she first saw Adam?" he asks. The Mother Superior thinks for a moment. "Oh\... that\'s a hard one."
punchline: "Congratulations," says St. Peter. "Welcome to heaven!"

title: THE RETURN VISIT
setup: A Martian arrives on Earth. Humanity has plenty of questions, so the U.N. arranges a conference. World leaders, public intellectuals, and religious leaders attend to ask their most burning questions. When it is the Pope\'s turn, he asks, "I was wondering\... have you ever heard of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ?" "Of course!" says the Martian. "He stops by our planet every couple of years, and we always have a great time." Stunned, the Pope says, "Surely you are mistaken. Jesus Christ was here about two thousand years ago, but he left, and we\'ve been waiting for his return ever since. Why would he visit you so often?" The Martian shrugs. "Well, maybe he didn\'t like the party." "The what?" the Pope asks.
punchline: "The party. When Jesus first showed up on our planet, we threw a huge celebration---music, dancing, food. It was great! Why? What did you guys do?"

title: INNER PEACE
setup: A spiritual teacher walks through a village with his disciples. Several opponents insult him, but he remains completely calm. One disciple asks, "Master, how can you stay so peaceful?" The teacher smiles. "If someone offers you a gift and you refuse it, who owns the gift?" "The person who offered it." "Exactly. So when they offer anger, I let them keep it." The disciple nods. "Beautiful."
punchline: The teacher whispers, "Also, I poisoned their well."

title: TONIGHT'S MENU
setup: A man is being held captive in a cage by a group of cannibals. With no way out, he whispers, "Oh God, I\'m so screwed!" A light shines down and the voice of God says, "No. In two hours they will take you from this cage. As you walk with them, a sparrow will fly overhead. Run left. The first man you see will be their leader. Kick him in the balls as hard as you can." Exactly two hours later, the cannibals take him out. A sparrow flies overhead. The prisoner runs left and kicks the first man with all his strength. The leader drops to his knees.
punchline: The light shines down again, and God says, "NOW you\'re screwed!"

title: HIGHER MANAGEMENT
setup: A visitor at a synagogue challenges the caretaker. "Are you important around here?" "I\'m above the janitor." "Above the rabbi?" "Yes." "Above the chief rabbi of the whole country?" "Still higher." "Then you\'re God?" "I\'m above God." The visitor shouts, "But there\'s nothing above God!"
punchline: The caretaker nods. "That\'s exactly what I am."

title: PLAN B
setup: A man finds an old lamp in the woods. A genie appears and offers one wish. "Bring my favorite dead singer back for one final concert." "Impossible," says the genie. "The paperwork for the dead is a nightmare. Pick something else." "Fine. Make the world\'s most famous pop star fall madly in love with me and marry me."
punchline: The genie goes quiet. "About that concert---would you prefer a stadium or a small theater?"

title: THE CONFESSIONAL
setup: A man staggers into a confessional. The priest sits on the other side. "My son, what can I do for you?"
punchline: "You got any toilet paper?"

title: SAME ORDER
setup: A man walks into a bar with a parrot on his shoulder. "Whiskey, please." The parrot adds, "And a Coke for me!" After the third interruption, the man warns him, "Ask again and I\'ll tape you to the wall." The parrot orders another Coke. The man tapes him to the wall beside a crucifix.
punchline: The parrot looks at Jesus and asks, "You order a Coke too?"

title: AN UNEXPECTED RISK
setup: A man tells a priest, "Father, everyone I talk to falls in love with me---my neighbor, her sister, my assistant, the housekeeper, even the baker." He keeps talking for ten minutes. Suddenly the priest grabs his sandals and runs for the door. "Father! Where are you going?"
punchline: Without looking back, the priest yells, "You've been talking to me for ten minutes! I'm leaving before we find out whether your story is true!"

title: A LARGE REQUEST
setup: A man rubs an old lamp and a genie appears. "I'll grant all your wishes!" "I want a giant palace with a hundred bedrooms, pools, gardens, fountains, and sports fields!"
punchline: The genie stares at him. "Think for two seconds. If I could build all that, do you really think I'd be living in a one-room lamp with no windows?"

title: FORTY YEARS OF FAITH
setup: Reporters in Jerusalem interview an old man at the Western Wall. "How often do you pray here?" "Every evening for forty years. I pray for peace, an end to hunger and disease, for the planet, my family, my friends---for all humanity." "And what has all that prayer brought you?"
punchline: The old man sighs. "Not much. Most days I feel like I'm talking to a wall."

title: LONG-DISTANCE RATES
setup: Two friends die in a crash and arrive in hell. The Devil allows one phone call at \$10,000 a minute. The first calls his wife for two minutes and owes \$20,000. The second chats with his cousin in Gary, Indiana, for two hours. The Devil checks the bill. "That'll be \$1.50." "Why so cheap?" the first man screams.
punchline: The Devil shrugs. "Hell to Gary is a local call."

title: TERMS AND CONDITIONS
setup: A man finds a genie in a bottle and is offered three wishes. The genie says, "I will grant your wishes, but there are three rules: you cannot bring back the dead, kill anyone who is alive, or wish for more wishes." The man says, "I wish envelopes and stamps moaned whenever someone licked them."
punchline: The genie pauses. "There are four rules."

title: THE CONVENT VISIT
setup: Three storks are carrying babies. "I\'m delivering mine to newlyweds." "Mine is for a couple who waited ten years." "And I\'m going to a convent." The others stare.
punchline: "I\'m not delivering anything. I just love scaring the hell out of them."

title: DIRECTIONS
setup: In a small town, a priest cannot find the post office. Everyone ignores him except a completely drunk man, who gives him perfect directions. After mailing his letter, the priest comes back. "You were very kind. To thank you, I\'d like to show you the way to God."
punchline: The drunk laughs. "You couldn\'t even find the post office."

title: THREE REASONS
setup: At a White House reception, a man asks a formally dressed guest to dance.
punchline: "No, for three reasons. First, nobody dances to the national anthem. Second, not in front of the President. Third, I\'m the Cardinal of New York."

title: AN UNUSUAL WAIT
setup: A mother insists that her pregnant daughter has never been near a man. The doctor stands and stares out the window at the sky. "What are you doing?"
punchline: "The last time this happened, a star appeared and three wise men showed up to explain it. I\'m waiting."

title: THE IDENTITY CHECK
setup: A famous painter reaches heaven and proves his identity by drawing a masterpiece. A celebrated novelist writes a brilliant paragraph. Then a reality-television star arrives and asks, "Who are those two?"
punchline: Saint Peter opens the gate. "That proves it. You\'re definitely a reality-television star."

title: AN AWKWARD INVITATION
setup: Judas asks Jesus, "Hey, are you coming to the Last Supper tonight?" Jesus stares at him. "The what?"
punchline: Judas quickly corrects himself. "The supper. I mean, are you coming to the supper tonight?"

title: THE COMPETITION
setup: An opera singer boasts that during his cathedral concert, a statue of the Virgin Mary began to cry.
punchline: A rival tenor replies, "At my concert overseas, the giant statue of Christ leaned down, hugged me, and said, \'Magnificent! Not like that other idiot who made my mother cry.\'"

title: THE IMPORTANT PASSENGER
setup: The Pope asks to drive his own limousine. On the highway he speeds and gets pulled over. The officer calls his chief. "I stopped someone extremely important." "A governor? The President?"
punchline: "More important. I don\'t know who he is, but the Pope is his chauffeur."

title: THE ATHEIST\'S SURPRISE
setup: An atheist dies and meets God. "Well," says God, "this is awkward."
punchline: The atheist nods. "For one of us, definitely."

title: THE GOLDEN STREETS
setup: A wealthy man arrives in heaven carrying a suitcase of gold bars. An angel opens it and laughs.
punchline: "You brought pavement?"

title: THE ETERNAL CLOCK
setup: In heaven, clocks spin faster each time someone lies. One man\'s clock never moves. "Was he perfectly honest?"
punchline: "No. We use his clock as the office fan."

title: THE DEVIL\'S DISCOUNT
setup: The Devil advertises, "Sell me your soul and get everything you want." A shopper asks, "Is there a free trial?"
punchline: The Devil smiles. "You\'re living it."

title: THE FINAL SERMON
setup: The preacher announced, "Tonight's sermon is about forgiving your enemies." Half the church stood up and left.
punchline: They had come to hear what was going to happen to their enemies.

title: THE ANSWERED PRAYER
setup: A man prays every night to win the lottery. After twenty years, a voice from heaven finally says:
punchline: "Meet me halfway. Buy a ticket."

title: THE HEAVENLY COMPLAINT
setup: A man reaches heaven and complains that his cloud is too small.
punchline: The angel checks his file. "Sir, that isn\'t a cloud. You are standing in the smoking section."

title: THE LAST CONFESSION
setup: A dying man tells the priest, "I stole, lied, cheated, and never felt guilty." The priest says, "Repent now and you may still enter heaven."
punchline: The man whispers, "Could you put that guarantee in writing?"

title: A BETTER ETERNITY
setup: The Devil offers a new arrival two choices: eternal fire or an endless committee meeting. The man chooses fire.
punchline: "Wise," says the Devil. "The meeting decides the fire temperature."

title: THE ADMISSION TEST
setup: At heaven\'s gate, the angel asks a lawyer for one honest statement. The lawyer says, "This will be difficult."
punchline: The gate opens immediately.

title: THE MIRACLE REVIEW
setup: A man asks God for a sign. His car starts, his phone charges, and the drive-through gets his order right.
punchline: He whispers, "Okay, now you\'re just showing off."

title: THE NEW COMMANDMENT
setup: A prophet returns from the mountain carrying a tablet. The crowd asks, "Is that a new commandment?"
punchline: "No. The old ones are now a subscription."

title: THE BEST DOOR
setup: The Devil shows a newcomer three rooms. In the first, people stand on their heads on sharp gravel. In the second, they stand on their heads on hard tile. In the third, everyone stands ankle-deep in sewage, drinking coffee and chatting. The man chooses the third room. He takes a mug and relaxes. A demon suddenly cracks a whip. "Coffee break is over!
punchline: Back on your heads!"

title: A BETTER ENDING
setup: People always say, "At least he died doing what he loved."
punchline: I want to die doing something I hate, so everyone can say, "Good. He didn't have to finish it."

title: DRY MONTH
setup: A month without alcohol improved my sleep, skin, mood, savings, and health.
punchline: Unfortunately, it also made every evening last nine hours.

title: CLIMATE CONTROL
setup: An engineer dies, lands in Hell by mistake, and installs air-conditioning, elevators, and plumbing. Heaven demands his return. The Devil refuses. God threatens to sue. The Devil laughs.
punchline: "Where are you going to find a lawyer up there?"

title: A SIGN FROM ABOVE
setup: I asked the universe for a sign.
punchline: It sent me a bill.

title: THE TEMPERATURE OF HELL
setup: A professor asks whether Hell is exothermic or endothermic. One student writes pages of equations and concludes: "If Hell expands slower than the number of arriving souls, the temperature rises. Based on my dating history, more people are entering than leaving.
punchline: Therefore, Hell is exothermic."

title: THE WAY OUT
setup: A man enters a cemetery and asks for the exit.
punchline: The caretaker says, "Straight ahead---for now."

title: A HEROIC MOMENT
setup: A woman is drowning beneath a huge seaside cliff while a crowd watches helplessly. Suddenly, a man dives from the rocks and swims straight toward her. The crowd erupts: "What a hero! What courage!"
punchline: The man surfaces and shouts, "Thanks---but when I get back up there, I want to know which jerk pushed me!"

title: THE SEATING PLAN
setup: A man jumps onto a bus and yells, "Nobody move! Women to the left, men to the right! I'm going to rob the women and kiss the men!" A woman protests, "Why not the other way around?"
punchline: A man in the back calls out, "Ma'am, please don't start changing the plan now that, for once, it's perfectly organized."

title: SANTA'S MAIL
setup: An orphan writes Santa asking for one hundred dollars. Moved, postal workers collect fifty and mail it to him. A week later they receive another letter:
punchline: "Dear Santa, thank you for the money. Next time, don't send it through the post office---the crooks kept half."

title: THREE MOTHERS
setup: Three Jewish mothers brag about their sons. The first says hers could buy all of New York City. The second says hers could buy New York and Los Angeles.
punchline: The third shrugs. "What makes you think my son wants to sell?"

title: A PARKING SPACE
setup: A late businessman circles the block, praying. "God, if you find me a space, I\'ll attend synagogue every day, give to the poor, and never miss another prayer." A truck pulls away from the perfect spot.
punchline: "Never mind, Lord. I found one."

title: THE FAMOUS FRIEND
setup: Dave brags to his boss, "I know everyone there is to know. Name anyone, and I know them." His boss calls his bluff. "How about the biggest action star in Hollywood?" They fly west. The star opens the door and shouts, "Dave! Great to see you! Come in for a beer!" Impressed but skeptical, the boss asks about the President. At the White House, the President spots Dave on a tour and waves him inside for a drink. Still not convinced, the boss names the Pope. They fly to Rome. Dave says, "I\'ll never catch his eye from here. I know the guards, so I\'ll go up to the balcony." Half an hour later, Dave appears beside the Pope. When he returns, his boss is on the ground with paramedics. "What happened?"
punchline: His boss looks up. "You and the Pope came out, and the man beside me asked, \'Who the fuck is that standing next to Dave?\'"

title: THE DEMONSTRATION
setup: Three admirals argue about whose sailors are bravest. The Russian orders a sailor to jump overboard, swim beneath the ship, and climb back up. The sailor obeys. The American orders one of his sailors to swim from bow to stern and back. He obeys too. The British admiral gives his sailor an even more dangerous order. The sailor looks him straight in the eye and says, "You can fuck right off, sir." The British admiral smiles.
punchline: "That, gentlemen, is courage."

title: THE IMPATIENT CUSTOMER
setup: A long line forms outside a store that has not opened yet. One man pushes all the way to the front. The first customer slaps him. Then everyone else slaps him, one after another, until he lands at the back of the line. He tries again and gets slapped all the way back a second time. Finally, he loses his temper.
punchline: "Fine! If that\'s how you\'re going to act, I\'m not opening the store today!"

title: TWO TICKETS
setup: A Broadway producer sends a famous critic two tickets for opening night with a note: "Bring a friend, if you have one." The critic sends them back with his reply:
punchline: "I can\'t attend opening night. I\'ll come to the second performance, if there is one."

title: THE MOVIE TICKET
setup: A Florida man buys a movie ticket. At the entrance, the usher tears it in half. He returns to the box office, buys another, and the usher tears that one too. After the fourth ticket, the cashier asks why he keeps coming back.
punchline: "Because the crazy woman at the door keeps destroying my tickets."

title: THE ROOFTOP
setup: The President and Vice President watch an angry demonstration from a rooftop. The President says, "All I want is to make these people happy."
punchline: The Vice President replies, "Then why don\'t you jump?"

title: THE NEW MONUMENT
setup: An American tourist asks a Paris cabdriver how long each landmark took to build. Every time, he says Americans would have built it ten times faster. They reach the Eiffel Tower. "What\'s that?" the tourist asks.
punchline: The driver shrugs. "No idea. It wasn\'t there yesterday."

title: THE TRAFFIC STOP
setup: A police officer stops a man leaving a very wet party. "Sir, you appear to be in a state of intoxication."
punchline: "No, Officer. I\'m in Tennessee."

title: THE MISSING OBJECT
setup: A Texan, a New Yorker, and a man from Michigan meet a genie. Each must throw something into the ocean; if the genie finds it, the man dies. The genie finds the Texan\'s toothpick and the New Yorker\'s nail. He searches forever for the Michigander\'s object.
punchline: "Keep looking," says the man. "I threw in a dissolving antacid tablet."

title: THE COMPLETE ANALYSIS
setup: Two idiots see something brown on the sidewalk. "Looks like shit." They touch it, smell it, and finally taste it.
punchline: "Yep, it\'s shit. Good thing we didn\'t step in it."

title: TRADITIONAL FORECASTING
setup: A trapper asks an old mountain man whether winter will be cold. "Very cold," says the old man. The trapper cuts more firewood and asks again. "Brutally cold." After stacking an enormous pile, the trapper asks how he can be so certain. The old man points to the wood.
punchline: "When a nervous fool cuts that much firewood, winter is usually very cold."

title: LANGUAGE SKILLS
setup: What do you call someone who speaks three languages? Trilingual. Two languages? Bilingual.
punchline: One language? American.

title: DIVINE BALANCE
setup: After creating California, God realized it had perfect weather, mountains, beaches, and fertile valleys.
punchline: To keep the other states from getting jealous, He created Californians.

title: STANDARD EQUIPMENT
setup: At a stoplight, the owner of a tiny customized car asks the driver of a luxury sedan whether it has GPS, television, and a refrigerator. It has everything except the refrigerator. The embarrassed driver installs a refrigerator and freezer, then finds the little car with steamed-up windows. He knocks to announce the upgrade.
punchline: "You interrupted my hot tub for that?" says the owner.

title: THE CAMPAIGN PROMISE
setup: A candidate promises to create thousands of jobs.
punchline: He wins, and every voter immediately needs a second one.

title: THE PUBLIC RECORD
setup: A senator says, "My record speaks for itself."
punchline: His attorney whispers, "That is exactly what we\'re trying to prevent."

title: THE NEW TAX FORM
setup: The government simplified the tax form to two questions: 1. How much did you make?
punchline: 2. Why do you still have it?

title: THE PRESS CONFERENCE
setup: A spokesperson begins, "We will now take questions." The reporters cheer.
punchline: "I didn\'t say we would answer them."

title: THE NATIONAL DEBT
setup: I tried to explain the national debt to my son.
punchline: He borrowed twenty dollars, spent thirty, and blamed his sister. He may be ready for office.

title: THE ETHICS COMMITTEE
setup: The ethics committee met behind closed doors.
punchline: They needed privacy to decide what transparency should look like.

title: THE LOBBYIST\'S BADGE
setup: A lobbyist enters the Capitol wearing a visitor badge.
punchline: The guard says, "You work here more than the lawmakers. Use the employee entrance."

title: THE EMERGENCY SESSION
setup: Lawmakers called an emergency session at midnight.
punchline: By sunrise, they had named a post office and blamed each other for the emergency.

title: THE FREEDOM PACKAGE
setup: The cable company added a "freedom package."
punchline: It lets you cancel anytime after a two-year contract, three phone calls, and a small hostage negotiation.

title: FISCAL TRIBUTE
setup: The city spent five million dollars building a monument to fiscal responsibility.
punchline: It came in ten million over budget.

title: THE FINAL VOTE
setup: A bill was six thousand pages long.
punchline: Every lawmaker voted confidently after reading the title.

title: THE LAST WISH
setup: A genie grants a man three wishes. "I want a world without lawyers." The genie nods. "Done. You have no wishes left." The man protests, "You said three!" The genie shrugs.
punchline: "Sue me."

title: VARIABLE TERMS
setup: A banker explains an adjustable-rate loan. The customer asks what it means.
punchline: "Neither of us knows what you'll pay, but I make money either way."

title: ONE QUESTION
setup: A man asks a lawyer, "How much do you charge for a question?" "Two hundred dollars." "Isn't that expensive?" The lawyer nods.
punchline: "Yes---and that answer brings your total to four hundred."

title: FRESH FROM THE OVEN
setup: A hungry man watches a baker pull fresh loaves from the oven. He sighs. "It's been more than a week since I tasted bread."
punchline: The baker nods kindly. "Don't worry, sir. The taste hasn't changed."

title: TRUST THE VOICE
setup: Every night a mysterious voice tells a man: "Quit your job. Sell everything. Go to Monte Carlo. Bet it all on nine." After weeks, he obeys. At the roulette table, the voice whispers, "Everything on nine." He places his entire fortune. The wheel spins, slows, and lands on thirteen.
punchline: The voice mutters, "Well... that's unfortunate."

title: A GENEROUS ANNOUNCEMENT
setup: A man bursts into a bar and shouts, "Free beer outside!" Everyone runs out. Seconds later, the screaming starts. "What did you do?" yells the bartender.
punchline: "Sorry. There are three grizzly bears out there. I honestly didn't think any of them would be brave enough to try it."

title: A STRANGE CONVERSATION
setup: A man says, "Today I saw a lunatic talking to his dog. When I got home, I told my cat.
punchline: We both laughed our asses off."

title: THE ONLY WITNESS
setup: On Fifth Avenue, a black truck stops in front of Tiffany & Co. An elephant climbs out, smashes the window, grabs the jewelry with its trunk, and escapes in the truck. The police question the only witness. "Did you get the license plate?" "No." "The make of the truck?" "No." "Was it an African elephant with large ears or an Asian elephant with small ears?"
punchline: The witness thinks. "Hard to say. He was wearing a ski mask."

title: WILDLIFE ENCOUNTER
setup: Two very drunk hunters spot a hang glider. The first says, "That\'s the biggest bird I\'ve ever seen." He fires. The pilot falls, but the glider keeps sailing. The second hunter says, "You missed."
punchline: The first lowers his rifle. "Maybe, but he dropped his prey."

title: LOCAL KNOWLEDGE
setup: Two drunk men are arguing under a streetlight. "I\'m telling you, that\'s the moon." "And I\'m telling you, it\'s the sun." They stop a passerby. "Excuse us. Is that the moon or the sun?"
punchline: The man looks up. "Sorry, I\'m not from this neighborhood."

title: A FAMILIAR FACE
setup: Two drunk men are sitting in a bar. The first looks into a mirror and says, "I know that guy. I\'m sure I\'ve seen him somewhere."
punchline: The second takes the mirror, studies it, and says, "Of course you know him, idiot. That\'s me."

title: THE OTHER ONE
setup: A man is walking two beautiful dogs. A passerby asks, "What breed are they?" "This one is a Labrador." "And the other one?" "The other one too." "Are they expensive?" "This one cost me a fortune." "And the other one?" "The other one too." The passerby finally asks, "Why do you always talk about this one first?" "Because this one is mine." "And the other one?"
punchline: "The other one too."

title: A LIMITED GENIE
setup: A man arrives in a Maserati. His friend offers to trade a beat-up Ford Pinto and a magic lamp for it. To prove the lamp works, the friend rubs it. A genie appears. "Genie, make us some tea." A teapot and two cups instantly appear. Amazed, the man accepts the trade. At home, he rubs the lamp in front of his wife. "Genie, give my wife a giant bag of diamonds!"
punchline: The genie shakes his head. "Sorry. I only know how to make tea."

title: SEAT ASSIGNMENT
setup: A man steps off an Amtrak train looking sick. His friend asks, "What happened to you?" "I rode the whole way facing backward." "Why didn\'t you switch seats?"
punchline: "I couldn\'t. There was nobody across from me to trade with."

title: LOYAL SUPPORT
setup: Mike tells Joe that he ran into a lion while hunting. "I started running." "The lion is faster than you." "So I climbed a tree." "Lions have claws. He climbed after you." "I crawled to the end of a branch." "He followed you." "I fell, found a hole, and hid underground." "The lion saw you. He dug you out and was about to eat you."
punchline: Mike finally snaps, "Whose side are you on, mine or the lion\'s?"

title: THE SCIENTIFIC HUNT
setup: A scientist explains how to capture a gorilla alive. He needs a pit bull, handcuffs, and a rifle. "I climb the tree and saw off the branch. The gorilla falls. The dog bites his balls, and while he grabs them, you cuff him." "What\'s the rifle for?"
punchline: "If I fall out of the tree instead, shoot the dog."

title: A POPULAR REQUEST
setup: At a funeral, a man learns that the widower\'s two vicious dogs ate both his wife and his mother-in-law. "Could I borrow those dogs?"
punchline: The widower points to the long procession behind him. "Get in line."

title: GETTING READY
setup: A man buys a centipede and asks it to go out for a beer. No answer. He asks again, then screams, "Are you coming or not?"
punchline: A tiny voice replies, "I heard you! I\'m putting on my shoes!"

title: THE NEW ROOMMATE
setup: An old woman begs the veterinarian to save her dying goat. "The only chance is to keep him warm inside your house." "That could be difficult because of the smell."
punchline: She thinks for a moment. "Well, the goat will just have to get used to it."

title: THE CONVERSATION
setup: An earthworm spots another worm beside him and tries to start a conversation. The other worm never answers.
punchline: After several questions, he sighs, "Damn it. I\'m talking to my own ass again."

title: THE CALL NEXT DOOR
setup: In a restroom stall, a man hears a voice from the next stall. "Hey, how are you?" He answers politely. The voice asks what he is doing, and he answers again.
punchline: Then the voice says, "Hang on, I\'ll call you back. Some idiot in the next stall keeps answering all my questions."

title: FAMILY RECIPE
setup: Two cannibals are eating dinner. One says, "I really don\'t like my mother-in-law."
punchline: The other replies, "Fine, but at least eat the vegetables."

title: THE ADAPTATION
setup: A dog watches a movie. He laughs, cries, and applauds at all the right moments.
punchline: His owner says, "This is incredible. He hated the book."

title: THE SECOND EAR
setup: A man burns his ear with an iron. "How did that happen?" "The phone rang, and I picked up the iron." "What happened to the other ear?"
punchline: "I tried to call the doctor."

title: EXCELLENT ROLE MODELS
setup: Children's stories are full of role models. One hero lives in a tree with no clothes. One princess sneaks out at midnight. One boy lies until his face changes shape. One thief is the good guy. One princess sleeps all day, and another moves in with seven men.
punchline: Then we act surprised when the children turn out strange.

title: THE WRONG ATHLETE
setup: Two angry fishermen hit a water-skier with an oar. When he doesn\'t surface, they dive in, retrieve a body, and start mouth-to-mouth. "His breath smells horrible!"
punchline: The other fisherman looks at the body\'s feet. "Stop. That\'s not him. This guy is wearing ice skates."

title: THE RIGHT DAY
setup: On a plane, a man asks the passenger beside him for the time. The passenger checks his watch. "Wednesday."
punchline: "Thanks. That\'s where I get off."

title: THE MAN ON THE ISLAND
setup: A ship passes an island where a bearded, half-naked man is waving his arms like a lunatic. A passenger alerts the captain.
punchline: "I know," says the captain. "Every time we pass his island, he goes crazy."

title: THE ROUNDABOUT
setup: A police officer stops a drunk driver. "Sir, your wife fell out of the car at the last traffic circle."
punchline: The man sighs with relief. "So that\'s why I thought I\'d gone deaf in one ear."

title: FILE SHARING
setup: A modern father explains to his son how he was born.
punchline: "Your mother and I connected on Facebook. I sent her a message, and we decided to share files. I inserted my USB stick into her port. We forgot the firewall, and nine months later, the virus arrived."

title: NOBODY IS AFRAID
setup: Every day a huge man walks into a bar. "Whiskey. And I am not paying, because I am afraid of nobody." The owner finally hires an even bigger man to sit at the bar. When the bully says his line, the big man stands up. "I am afraid of nobody either."
punchline: The bully turns to the bartender. "Then make it two whiskeys. Neither of us is paying."

title: THE FAMILY THREAT
setup: A man cannot find the keys to his sports car outside a bar. "I will count to three. If my keys don\'t return, I\'ll do exactly what my grandfather did twenty years ago!" Terrified, the customers return the keys. "What did your grandfather do?"
punchline: "He walked home."

title: THE NEXT ACTIVITY
setup: An old man asks a fisherman three times, "So, are we fishing?" Annoyed, the fisherman packs his gear and rides his bicycle up the hill. At the top, he sees the old man waving frantically. Thinking he forgot something, he rides all the way back down.
punchline: The old man smiles. "So, are we biking now?"

title: THE MALL MACHINE
setup: A father and son who have never seen an elevator watch an elderly woman enter one. Moments later, the doors open and a gorgeous young woman walks out.
punchline: The father whispers, "Son, go get your mother."

title: THE ESCAPE PLAN
setup: Three prisoners plan an escape. The one on cocaine wants to bend the bars and beat every guard. The one on LSD wants to become liquid metal, slide under the door, and transform into a butterfly.
punchline: The one smoking weed asks, "Why escape? Isn\'t it nice here, guys?"

title: THE STRANGE EGG
setup: Six eggs sit in a refrigerator. Five of them stare nervously at the sixth, who is brown and covered in hair.
punchline: Finally one whispers, "Relax, you idiots. He's a kiwi."

title: THE DISAPPEARANCE
setup: Three hamburger patties are walking together. Suddenly, two disappear. The third searches everywhere until they reappear. "Where were you?"
punchline: "Playing hide-and-meat."

title: THE ISOLATED MARRIAGE
setup: A boy and girl from neighboring farms grow up together, attend school together, and reach adulthood without ever leaving the countryside. One day he says, "We should get married."
punchline: "I\'d love to," she replies, "but to whom? We don\'t know anybody."

title: THE CORRECT CAR
setup: Outside a bar, a very drunk man pats the roofs of every car in the lot. "How will that help you find yours?" asks the bartender.
punchline: "Easy. Mine has blue lights on top."

title: TWO NEIGHBORS
setup: A tavern opens opposite a cemetery and hangs a sign: "Whatever people say or do, it is better in here than across the street." The cemetery posts a reply:
punchline: "Whatever people say or do, everyone in here came from across the street."

title: THE RARE RESOURCE
setup: Money is like toilet paper. You only respect it when there is almost none left.
punchline: At two sheets, it stops being paper and becomes a strategy.

title: THE ELECTRIC RACKET
setup: Put an electric bug racket in the hands of the gentlest person alive and they become a psychopath.
punchline: My grandmother even hunted mosquitoes outdoors, swinging at them like she was playing center court in a championship final.

title: THE HUMAN TEST
setup: A website asked me to click every square containing a traffic light. I clicked the light. Then I clicked the pole, because the pole is part of the light.
punchline: The screen replied: "Please try again. You are a robot."

title: THE EMERGENCY KIT
setup: My emergency kit contains water, batteries, a flashlight, and chocolate.
punchline: If disaster lasts longer than the chocolate, I accept nature\'s decision.

title: THE NEW PET
setup: I bought a goldfish because the store said it was low maintenance.
punchline: Now it watches me eat seafood with the calm patience of a future witness.

title: THE ELEVATOR BUTTON
setup: I was in a hurry, so I pressed the elevator button eleven times. It arrived at exactly the same speed.
punchline: But I felt like a man who had done everything he could.

title: THE MISSING SOCK
setup: My washing machine does not eat socks.
punchline: It collects one from each pair so it can eventually build a complete person.

title: THE ACCURATE HOROSCOPE
setup: My horoscope said I would face an unexpected financial loss.
punchline: Then the app charged me for the premium prediction.

title: THE RESTAURANT SIGN
setup: The sign said, "Breakfast served anytime."
punchline: So I ordered pancakes during the Renaissance.

title: THE TALKING DOG
setup: A man sells a talking dog for ten dollars. "Why so cheap?" asks the buyer. "Because he lies about everything," says the owner.
punchline: The dog leans over and whispers, "He only says that because I know where he buried the bodies."

title: THE HELPFUL MIRROR
setup: My mirror says I look tired.
punchline: It never uses words. That somehow makes it ruder.

title: THE TIME TRAVELER
setup: A time traveler walks into a bar. The bartender says, "We don\'t serve time travelers here." The traveler looks confused.
punchline: "That\'s not what you said tomorrow."

title: AN UNUSUAL DETAIL
setup: A man tells police, "The thief was about six feet tall and wore a mask." "Anything distinctive?"
punchline: "Yes. He kept correcting my grammar."

title: THE BROKEN CLOCK
setup: A broken clock is right twice a day.
punchline: Mine is digital. It says 12:00 all day long and has never once doubted itself.

title: THE HAUNTED HOUSE
setup: I spent one night in a haunted house. At midnight, a ghost whispered, "Get out."
punchline: I said, "You first. I paid the deposit."

title: THE LAST COOKIE
setup: There was one cookie left, so I cut it exactly in half.
punchline: One half was for me. The other half was also for me, because fairness should begin at home.

title: THE SCREEN-TIME RULE
setup: A father promises to put his phone away whenever his children are in the room. He keeps the promise for three weeks by staying out of the room.
punchline: When he finally walks in, his toddler waves and says, "Thanks for watching. Please subscribe."

title: THE SCHOOL MASCOT
setup: A school picks a chameleon as its mascot. At the first game it turns the colors of the visiting team and cheers every goal they score. "That is humiliating," says the principal.
punchline: "Maybe," says the coach, "but it is the only one of us that picked the winning side."

title: PARENTHOOD MATH
setup: Children take your sleep, your money, and your waistline, then ask why you look so tired.
punchline: I am young enough to be mistaken for their brother and tired enough to be mistaken for their grandfather.

title: FRAGILE
setup: The first child is carried like glass.
punchline: The second is carried like a suitcase marked FRAGILE. Everyone reads the label. Nobody throws it any softer.

title: BORROWED FACE
setup: I used my friend's ID to enter a club.
punchline: The hard part wasn't the age---it was maintaining his unfortunate facial expression.

title: THE UNINVITED GUEST
setup: There was a spider in my shower big enough to make eye contact. At that size it is not a pest. It is a tenant. I carried it outside and said, "One of us had to go, and I pay the mortgage."
punchline: It walked straight toward my neighbor's house. Good. Let him handle the rent.

title: ROADSIDE PRECISION
setup: A road sign said, "Drive sober on highways."
punchline: So the side streets are officially open for business.

title: THE PREMIUM FLIGHT
setup: At the gate, a nervous passenger notices that his flight is called Flight 10. "Why such a small number?" he asks.
punchline: The agent smiles. "The first nine were prototypes."

title: THE PHOTO OPPORTUNITY
setup: A man agrees to hold a giant pet snake because the owner promises it is harmless. He bravely wraps it around his shoulders. Then the owner says the photograph costs twenty dollars. The man immediately hands back the snake. "I trust reptiles," he explains.
punchline: "It's photographers I'm afraid of."

title: THE FATHER'S DAY GIFT
setup: For Father's Day my children gave me a gift card to a thrift store. "It means we were thinking of you," they said.
punchline: I turned it over. Thirty-seven cents. "It also means you stopped thinking somewhere around thirty-eight."

title: THE FINAL CHECK
setup: Two hunters are in the woods when one collapses and stops breathing. The other calls emergency services. "My friend is dead! What do I do?" The operator says, "First, make sure he's really dead." There is a silence, then a gunshot. The hunter returns to the phone. "Okay.
punchline: Now what?"

title: STARGAZING
setup: A famous detective and his assistant go camping. In the middle of the night, the detective wakes him. "Look at the stars. What do you deduce?" The assistant gives a long speech about planets, galaxies, and life beyond Earth. The detective sighs.
punchline: "I deduce that someone stole our tent."

title: EMERGENCY DESIGN
setup: Why do ducks have webbed feet? To stamp out fires. Why do elephants have flat feet?
punchline: To stamp out burning ducks.

title: THE FISH TANK
setup: Two goldfish are swimming in a tank.
punchline: One turns to the other and asks, "Do you know how to drive this thing?"

title: THE BIG GAME
setup: Two flies are playing soccer in a saucer. One says, "Try harder.
punchline: We're playing in the cup tomorrow."

title: ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE
setup: I picked up a hitchhiker.
punchline: It seemed polite after I hit him.

title: QUANTUM DRINKING
setup: Schrödinger's cat walks into a bar.
punchline: And doesn't.

title: A MINOR PROBLEM
setup: A musical note walks into a bar.
punchline: The bartender says, "Sorry, we don't serve minors."

title: SIDEWALK FISHING
setup: A man sees an old woman fishing in a puddle with a stick and string. Feeling sorry for her, he buys her a drink. "How many have you caught today?" She smiles.
punchline: "You're the eighth."

title: THE SEAL'S ORDER
setup: A seal walks into a bar. "What'll it be?" asks the bartender.
punchline: "Anything but a club soda."

title: A FAST ATTACK
setup: A snail is mugged by two turtles. Police ask for a description. The snail says, "I don't know.
punchline: It all happened so fast."

title: ARMORED FISH
setup: Two fish are in a tank. One says, "You handle the gun.
punchline: I'll drive."

title: THE LONG FACE
setup: A horse walks into a bar. "Why the long face?" asks the bartender. The horse shrugs.
punchline: "Genetics."

title: SPECIES CONFUSION
setup: Two cows are talking. "Aren't you afraid of mad cow disease?" The other says, "Why would I be?
punchline: I'm a horse."

title: FUTURE TRAVEL
setup: Two caterpillars watch a butterfly.
punchline: One says, "You'll never get me up in one of those things."

title: EXACT DIRECTIONS
setup: I have an excellent sense of direction.
punchline: I always know exactly where I got lost.

title: NO REGRETS
setup: I decided to live without regrets.
punchline: I've regretted that decision three times today.

title: BACKUP PLAN
setup: A man buys two tickets as he boards a bus. The inspector asks why. "If I lose one, I'll still have the other." "And if you lose both?"
punchline: "Then I'll use my annual pass."
